title: CORE: Concept-Oriented Reinforcement for Bridging the Definition-Application Gap in Mathematical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2512.18857v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often solve challenging math exercises yet fail to apply the concept right when the problem requires genuine understanding. Popular Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) pipelines reinforce final answers but provide little fine-grained conceptual signal, so models improve at pattern reuse rather than conceptual applications. We introduce CORE (Concept-Oriented REinforcement), an RL training framework that turns explicit concepts into a controllable supervision signal. translated_title: CORE：面向概念的强化学习方法，弥合数学推理中定义与应用的鸿沟
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）往往能够解答有难度的数学练习题，但在需要真正理解概念时却无法正确运用。流行的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）流程只强化最终答案，却几乎不提供细粒度的概念信号，因此模型提升的是模式复用能力而非概念应用能力。我们提出了CORE（Concept-Oriented REinforcement，面向概念的强化），这是一个将显式概念转化为可控监督信号的强化学习训练框架。基于一份高质量、低污染的教科书资源（该资源将可验证的练习题与简洁的概念描述关联起来），我们进行了一项健全性探测，结果表明LLM能够复述定义，却在概念关联测验上失败，从而量化了概念推理的差距。随后，CORE（i）合成概念对齐的测验题，（ii）在推理过程中注入简短的概念片段以引出概念激发的轨迹，（iii）强化…
tldr: CORE框架将显式概念转化为可控的强化学习监督信号，通过合成概念对齐测验、在推理中注入概念片段等方式，弥合了大语言模型“能复述定义却不会应用概念”的数学推理鸿沟。
en_tdlr: CORE is an RL framework that bridges the definition-application gap in LLM mathematical reasoning by turning explicit concepts into controllable supervision signals, synthesizing concept-aligned quizzes, and injecting concept snippets during rollouts to reinforce concept-grounded reasoning.
